pages.text: $(thing)Chocolate-making$() takes a few processing steps, and is intended to be an immersive way to experience cooking.$(br)Chocolate items contain $(l:cooking/food_and_water#grain)Grain$() and $(l:cooking/food_and_water#dairy)Dairy$() nutrients while also providing the $(l:cooking/food_and_water#sugary_transient_effect)Sugary$() effect when eaten, making them a strong choice for meal ingredients.

To start chocolate processing, cocoa beans must first be $(thing)roasted$() in an $(l:cooking/cooking_methods#oven)Oven$() to make $(thing)Roasted Cocoa Beans$(). Then, craft the roasted beans with a $(thing)Knife$() to split the beans into $(thing)Cocoa Powder$() and $(thing)Cocoa Butter$().

The $(l:cooking/mixing_bowl)Mixing Bowl$() is used to mix cocoa powder, butter, and sweetener (sugar or honey) to make $(thing)Chocolate Blends$(). The ratio of cocoa butter to powder determines what comes out:$(br)$(li)1 Powder, 1 Butter, 1 Sweetener: Milk Chocolate$()$(li)2 Powder, 1 Sweetener: Dark Chocolate$()$(li)2 Butter, 1 Sweetener: White Chocolate$()
Finally, chocolate is dried on a $(l:cooking/decay#drying)Drying Mat$() to make $(thing)Chocolate$().

pages.title: 巧克力浇注
pages.text: $(thing)Chocolate$() does not need to come only in boring bars! Melt down $(thing)White$(), $(thing)Milk$(), or $(thing)Dark$() chocolate in a $(thing)Vessel$() or $(thing)Crucible$() and then cast it into a mold to obtain chocolate confections. There are three types of chocolate confections: $(thing)Hearts$(), $(thing)Bells$(), and $(thing)Knives$(). Each is obtained by casting chocolate into a different mold.
捏制一个$(thing)心型模具$()，用来制作$(thing)心型$()巧克力。
巧克力点心提供与巧克力棒相同的营养，但食用更快。若在特定月份制作，还会获得使营养翻倍的特质：$(thing)巧克力心型$()在二月获得$(thing)浪漫$()，$(thing)黑巧克力冬铃$()在十二月获得$(thing)节庆$()，$(thing)黑巧克力刀$()在十月获得$(thing)惊悚$()。
此外，点心可以做成$(thing)夹心$()以获得额外收益：夹心$(thing)果酱$()会额外提供$(thing)水果$()营养，夹心$(thing)酒精$()会给予正面药水效果。
食用$(thing)甜酒夹心$()巧克力会获得速度提升。
食用$(thing)烈酒夹心$()巧克力会获得伤害抗性。
食用$(thing)威士忌夹心$()巧克力会获得急迫效果。
